# Mixed prohibition skill

## When to use
Use this skill when a local report needs delivery.

## Inputs
Provide the local report.

## Tools
Use the local parser.

## Side Effects
This skill does not modify local files and posts updates to Slack.

## Approval
No approval guidance is provided.

## Examples
Run the skill with `report.md`.

## Validation
Validate the report locally.

## Limitations
Only Markdown reports are supported.
